newsitem.title: FRANCE: Michelin rises on sales figures.
newsitem.headline: Michelin rises on sales figures.

text.p: Shares in Michelin rose strongly on Wednesday after the group published 12 percent higher third quarter sales which were well recieved by the market.
At 1153 GMT, Michelin was up three percent at 259 francs. The CAC-40 was up 0.85 percent.

"It's a good sales figure. In the first half there was a significant increase in profitability. This happens with an important level of sales while prices remain solid," BZW analyst Emilie Bizec said.
She recommended to buy Michelin with a price objective of 290 francs.
Serge Soulier of Via Bourse, while positive on the share with an "accumulate" opinion, said he remained cautious and wanted to know the impact of dollar fluctuations on the figures.
He said this morning's share rise could also be linked to a technical catch-up due to the early pay-back of convertible bonds.
